item.title: Prep softball: American Canyon dominates in first-ever win over Benicia
item.description: Behind a 10-strikeout outing from senior starting pitcher Kate Sosa and a monster 5-RBI day from senior first baseman Ianna Lobao, American Canyon grabbed the program’s first-ever win over Benicia — a 10-0 run-rule victory in five innings.

item.title: Trial setting delayed in Dixon stabbing case
item.description: A Dixon man charged in connection with the fatal stabbing of a 21-year-old Vacaville man in August had the setting of his trial date delayed again in Solano County Superior Court on Thursday. Brian James Sweeney, 44, will return to Department 25 on April 3 at 8:30 a.m. for the setting of a trial date by Judge Janice M. Williams. item.title: NorthBay in talks to buy Queen of the Valley in Napa
item.description: NorthBay Health is in negotiations with Providence Health to buy Napa’s Queen of the Valley Medical Center and its related assets, both health systems confirmed Thursday. Both organizations released statements touting their desire to continue Queen of the Valley’s stellar legacy.
